description: This file defines the WaveState class responsible for handling signal waveforms (up-down triggers) within the engine trigger system. It manages signal transitions, stores waveform data, and provides utility methods for processing engine trigger signals.

classes.name: WaveState
classes.description: Class that manages waveform trigger states, processes signal transitions, and maintains a list of engine report up-down events.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming trigger signal signals (up or down), updates internal state, and records up-down events.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Finalizes waveform processing by adding a closing event if needed.

methods.name: getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the latest downTime from the list of recorded events.
